label: Indonesia
short_description: Marriott Bonvoy hotels in Indonesia, split between Bali's resort coastline and Jakarta's business district.
intro: Indonesia's Bonvoy coverage in this directory spans two very different markets: Bali's beach and resort-focused properties across the south of the island, and Jakarta's business and shopping-district hotels aimed at corporate travelers and city stays. The two rarely overlap in trip purpose, so most searches land on one city or the other rather than both.
